title: AP is mum on potential review of Dianna Russini's NFL awards ballots

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: AP is mum on potential review of Dianna Russini's NFL awards ballots
sources.description: Despite Dianna Russini's recent resignation from The Athletic, the company continues to review her reporting in the aftermath of the photos with Patriots coach Mike Vrabel that emerged twelve days ago.
